title: gui-player configuration
description: Describes every entry of `settings` in gui-player.json (which lives next to the executable and is created with the defaults when missing). The file holds the current values as a list of {key, value}; this schema holds everything else about them. settingType USER entries are shown in Tools > Settings, built from controlType and values; SYSTEM entries are state the application keeps for itself (window, dividers). values.defaultValue is used when an entry is missing or invalid and by 'Restore default'; it may be absent for SYSTEM entries with no meaningful default. Also in the file, outside `settings`: `lastOpened`, the history of opened compositions (most recent first, absolute paths as {key, value}).

maxLastOpened.settingDescription: Maximum number of files kept in File > Open recent.

windowMaximized.settingDescription: Whether the window was left maximized. When false it opens restored, at windowX/windowY with windowWidth x windowHeight.

windowX.settingDescription: Horizontal position of the restored window. Without it (or without windowY) the system places the window.

windowY.settingDescription: Vertical position of the restored window. See windowX.

windowWidth.settingDescription: Width of the restored window, in points.

windowHeight.settingDescription: Height of the restored window, in points.

tabsWidthPercent.settingDescription: Share of the width of A + B taken by the tabs panel (A). Position of the vertical divider; minValue and maxValue are how far it can be dragged.

arrangementHeightPercent.settingDescription: Share of the height taken by the arrangement (C); A + B get the rest. Position of the horizontal divider; minValue and maxValue are how far it can be dragged.
